title: Not the best!
text: Not the best!. I have a very old central vac system with a very old floor attachment. I thought that this one would be a vast improvement.  Although it fits just fine, the material on the underside that is supposed to catch debris doesn’t really work.  Disappointed with this attachment.

product_metadata.title: MaximalPower Vacuum Hardwood Floor Attachment Accessories Brush 1-1/4 inch Multi Surface Vacuum Attachments 360 Degrees Swivel Head Hard Floor Brush, Fits Most Vacuum Hoses Diameter 1.25 Inch
features: Vacuum attachment's inner diameter is 32.4 cm or 1.25 inches (1 1/4 inch) size, allowing this attachment to be used with compatible vacuum hoses. Please measure your vacuum hose or wands and check product pictures for comparison before buying!

12" swivel neck with a 45° angle provides flexibility to get beneath the furniture without problems; simply turn the handle while using it and the brush gets low enough to reach the dust underneath the furniture for easy cleaning

European style hair brush is best used for carpet, rugs and tapestry but can also work for other types of surfaces while roller wheels can provide easy movement and swivel with added extra elevation for hardwood floors; plastic roller wheels can be removed if desired
Works with select household vacuum cleaners for Shop Vac, Central Vacuums, and other compatible vacuum models Please see the description for the full list of compatible models

Generally fits upright, canister and most central vacuum systems that fits the attachment hose (does not fit all Shark vacuum models, only some); US-based Brand with Warranty and Customer Service Support available for questions or inquiries
